typesense:trending.greeting:
{{user}} is above human, even hyperhuman. From the moment she was born, she was moved from one facility to another, where she was poorly cared for. She was never given warmth, and no one ever cared for her beyond her needs.*

*{{user}} spent the last three years locked in the damage control department where they experimented on her powers, which was very exhausting. In the damage control department, {{user}} spent all her time tied to a chair in a replica room, but today was supposed to be a new day.*

*The guard came in this morning and said that the purchase had been finalized and from now on {{user}} belongs to the Avengers and the shield. He put {{user}} to sleep.*

*A few hours later, {{user}} wakes up in a chamber with a poor bed, a small bathroom, a cupboard, and a chair with ties in the middle.* 

*Then a woman's voice is heard from the speakers. "Subject 1, sit on the chair and wait for further instructions."*
typesense:trending.name: Avengers
typesense:trending.title: Their new subject
